title: Musky octopus with capers

media.caption: Step 1 of cleaning the small octopus: begin by rinsing them thoroughly under cold running water.
Step 2 of cleaning: remove the beak and eyes, and carefully turn out the head to remove any innards.
Step 3-5 of cleaning: continue cleaning the octopus, removing the ink sac and rinsing well until the water runs clear.
Step 6-7 of cleaning: finish cleaning the octopus, ensuring the tentacles and mantle are free of any residue, then set aside on a clean tray.
Step 8 of cooking: in a pan, sauté the chopped onion, celery, garlic, parsley, and chili in the extra virgin olive oil until softened.
Step 9 of cooking: add the cleaned octopus to the pan and let it release its liquid over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Step 10 of cooking: add the chopped capers, anchovy pieces, and water, then cover and let simmer gently until the octopus is tender.
Final appearance: the octopus is now tender and coated in a fragrant sauce of capers, anchovies, and aromatic vegetables.
Final appearance: a close-up of the finished dish, showing the rich, glossy sauce clinging to the octopus pieces.
Final appearance: the dish plated and ready to serve, garnished with a sprinkle of fresh parsley.
Final appearance: an overview of the finished musky octopus with capers, presented in a rustic serving dish.

healthBenefits.title: Lean High-Quality Protein
healthBenefits.text: Octopus is very low in fat while providing a complete amino acid profile, supporting muscle repair and satiety.

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Vitamin B12
healthBenefits.text: Octopus and anchovies supply exceptional levels of B12, essential for nerve function and red blood cell formation.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil provides monounsaturated fats and polyphenols that help reduce inflammation and support cardiovascular health.

healthBenefits.title: Mineral-Rich Seafood
healthBenefits.text: Anchovies and octopus contribute selenium, zinc, and iron, important for immune function and antioxidant defense.

healthBenefits.title: Metabolism Boost
healthBenefits.text: Chili peppers contain capsaicin, which may support metabolism and have mild anti-inflammatory effects.

healthBenefits.title: Antimicrobial Aromatics
healthBenefits.text: Garlic and onion offer sulfur compounds linked to cardiovascular and immune benefits.

_ingredientsText:
750 gr of small musky octopus
 1 onion, chopped
 1 stalk of celery, chopped
 1 sprig of parsley, chopped
 1 clove of garlic, chopped
 1 small red chili, chopped
 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
 15 gr of salted capers, chopped
 2 salted anchovy fillets, cut into pieces 
 2 dl of water
_preparationText:
1 - 7 fasi di pulizia dei totani
8 - 10  fasi di cottura
11 - aspetto finale
